title: Rustinel preview register (v1)
description: Schema for preview/preview.yml, the register of non-production detection content. Every file under preview/ must have exactly one entry here, and no production pack may reference an id listed in it.

id.description: The artifact's own id — unchanged by the move, so promotion keeps the identity.

path.description: Path to the artifact, relative to preview/.

state.description: telemetry-blocked = a required field is never populated; rewrite-required = shaped for a different sensor; test-only = harness fixture, never a detection.

missing_fields.description: For telemetry-blocked entries: the '<category>.<Field>' entries that are never populated.

blocker.description: Issue URL that would unblock promotion, when one exists.
